Introduction

GroovyRoom is a South Korean DJ, music producing, and composing duo consisting of Park Gyu-jeong (IÖN) and Lee Hwi-min (Lil Moshpit). Known for their signature producer tag "Groovy Everywhere," they primarily produce hip-hop tracks, often exploring boom bap and trap sounds.

Since their debut single "Loyalty" in 2016 and their first EP "Everywhere" in 2017, they have become a prominent force in the Korean music scene, working with numerous popular artists and receiving several awards, including Producer of the Year at the Korean Hip-hop Awards. In 2021, they further expanded their influence by launching their own label, AREA, in partnership with H1ghr Music.
